_note: Selection Watch owner settings. Preview fixtures are public files. Menu wording and normal tab visibility belong in nav.json.

labels._note: Owner-facing feature name. Section headings and required disclosures are part of the page UI.
labels._title_note: Feature name in the page title, heading and export. Change the menu label separately in nav.json.
labels.title: Selection Watch

_export_filename_prefix_note: Prefix for downloaded images. The section ID and .png are appended.

previews._note: Each mode needs enabled: true and both query and url. Use distinct query values. A missing, disabled or ambiguous mode does not load a preview.

historical._query_note: Value after ?preview= for the historical replay.
historical._url_note: Historical fixture URL relative to the report page.

provisional._enabled_note: Allow the explicitly marked provisional board when true.
provisional._query_note: Value after ?preview= for the provisional board.
provisional._url_note: Provisional fixture URL relative to the report page. Its data must be marked provisional.

_field_exceptions_note: Archive only. Real playoff fields that differ from the rules because of an admin error, keyed by season. Each entry swaps one team: 'in' played in the field, 'out' qualified by rule but was left out. The archive board is drawn by the rules and marks both teams with a dagger. Delete an entry (or the whole block in a fresh template) to drop the exception; that season then shows no board.

2022.note: Bracket entry error: Central Michigan was placed in the field instead of Texas Tech. Results stand as played.

_availability_message_note: Message shown when the live data file has not been published. Update or remove the date for future seasons.
availability_message: Available after the regular season is final (Tue Nov 24).

timeline._note: Checkpoint windows in Eastern time with explicit UTC offsets. After each opens, record its first verified refresh with all NFL games starting before through complete. Expired missing windows are never backfilled.

dark_swap._note: Dark mode only (Chris, 2026-11-20). A team whose main colour (background) is under max_background_contrast against the dark card panel, and whose text colour is at least min_text_contrast against it, has its two colours swapped on its card: text becomes the card colour (blended by odds as usual) and background becomes the preferred text colour. The 4.5:1 text check still applies with black/white fallback. Light mode is unchanged.
